upstreamDescription: Reference organ assembly created using the Visible Human Female dataset, National Library of Medicine.

registration.method: Native donor geometry; common rigid translation only. No transfer from BodyParts3D or sex morphing.
limitations: The HRA organ set is an anatomical reference assembly, not a complete dissection of a single individual.
No skull, ribs, shoulder girdle, upper-limb skeleton, hands or feet are supplied. Most skeletal muscles and peripheral nerves are absent.
Six lumbar-labelled source meshes are retained as one source lumbar region; no diagnosis of a transitional vertebra is inferred.
Pregnancy reference objects (placenta, amnion and umbilical cord) and the separate Yao lymph-node specimen are excluded.
No separately selectable clitoris, labia, female urethra or pelvic-floor muscles are supplied. The external perineal skin is smooth and does not depict a detailed vulva.

modifications: Curated anatomical selection; source patches grouped into selectable organs; one common vertical translation; original triangles retained; educational materials and bilingual labels added. No male geometry, sex morph, remeshing or invented surfaces. Separate original educational reconstructions supplement the missing external genital and urethral structures; these are labelled as reconstructions and are not HRA segmentations. The retained HRA surface coordinates and triangles are unchanged.

sourceLabelIssues.issue: The raw left/right names and crosswalk for the round uterine ligaments are reversed relative to their coordinates and uterine/ovarian attachments.
sourceLabelIssues.handling: Kept as one bilateral structure; raw names and ontology IDs preserved without asserting the erroneous laterality.

exclusions: Placenta, amnion and umbilical cord are pregnancy reference models, excluded from the adult baseline.
Separate Yao lymph-node specimen is excluded.
Allen brain subdivisions and unreviewed small vascular/airway/eye annotations are outside this curated subset.
Uterovesical pouch and isolated abdominal tubal ostium reference surfaces are excluded, not presented as solid organs.
Skull, ribs, shoulder girdle, upper-limb skeleton, hand/foot bones, most muscles and peripheral nerves are not supplied by this reference organ set.
Clitoris, labia, female urethra and pelvic-floor muscles have no separate source meshes. The external perineal skin is smooth and does not depict a detailed vulva.

reconstructedSupplement.source: Original mathematical teaching reconstruction for Atom2Universe
reconstructedSupplement.sourceGeometry: No third-party genital mesh copied, traced, registered or modified.
reconstructedSupplement.referenceData: Published measurements and anatomical relationships guide an illustrative example, not a patient-specific or average shape.

registration.kind: Original illustrative reconstruction, not a segmented specimen
registration.coordinateSystem: Native HRA female: X subject left, Y superior, Z anterior. Apply the same Y+0.794760942 translation as the base atlas.
rationale: Jackson et al. 2019, DOI10.1016/j.ajog.2019.06.048: measured glans/body/crura dimensions and glans-to-urethra distance guide scale, not an exact population-average shape.
Lloyd et al. 2005, DOI10.1111/j.1471-0528.2004.00517.x: broad ranges of labial dimensions; the reconstructed folds are one non-normative example.

O'Connell et al. 2005, PMID15879834, DOI10.1097/01.ju.0000158446.21396.c0: clitoral corpora/crura and bulbs surround the urethrovaginal complex anterolaterally. Bulbs and crura remain separately named.

Attari et al. 2021, DOI10.1007/s10439-021-02765-4 and Liu et al. 2025, DOI10.1007/s00192-025-06045-w: the female urethra is curved and related to the anterior vaginal wall, not a male urethra with the penile part removed.
limitations: These meshes are mathematical teaching surfaces. They are not MRI/CT segmentation, donor-specific reconstruction, medical simulation or a clinical reference.

The existing HRA vagina has a closed distal segmentation and the skin has no detailed vulva. Both remain byte-for-byte unchanged; the supplement does not create a continuous native vaginal lumen or holes in the native skin.
The urethral wall has an illustrative open lumen and a proximal surface connection to the HRA bladder neck. The HRA neck is capped: no continuous fluid connection with the bladder lumen is claimed.

The native HRA bladder neck already intersects the right pubic surface. The reconstructed proximal wall narrows towards the posterior neck margin and curves behind the pubis; this does not repair the source overlap or establish a precise donor-specific junction.

Each named part is an independently selectable teaching surface, not a volumetric tissue partition. Overlap remains where the outer labial folds cover the deeper bulbs and crura; hidden-part selection can expose these illustrative interfaces.
Fine skin texture, clitoral hood, vessels, nerves, suspensory attachments, vestibular glands and pelvic-floor musculature are not reconstructed. Labial shapes and dimensions vary widely.

sourceSearch.FillodCosentino: Official source licence CC BY-NC-SA: excluded, including conflicting CC0/CC BY mirrors.
sourceSearch.UNIGE: 3D kits not found as meshes with a verified freely redistributable licence; the CC BY-SA statement in the 2020 paper concerns 2D drawings.
sourceSearch.Wu2020: Interactive pelvic-floor PDF is advertised, but mesh reuse licence and downloadable geometry were not verified.
sourceSearch.Kiesel2022: Article open access; STL files available only by author request, no downloadable licensed mesh identified.

packaging.format: Draco-compressed GLB in independent gzip members; concatenate decompressed parts in modelParts order

externalVisibility.scope: External genitalia only; internal reproductive organs retained

surfaceAdaptation.scope: External genital display only; internal organs and breast silhouette retained
surfaceAdaptation.clinicalUse: Illustrative reversible display closure, not anatomy
surfaceAdaptation.skin: HRAF_2 already has a smooth perineum. Detailed external structures are separate meshes; no female skin or urethra variant is needed.

mobileOptimization.method: Mobile display derivative: exact attribute welding; error-bounded meshoptimizer simplification with locked borders, extrema and a triangle in every connected island; per-mesh Draco position quantization (14/16 bits, 20 or lossless when needed to keep islands separate) and normals (10 bits). Names, materials, layers and display variants retained.
mobileOptimization.sourceGeometryNote: Source descriptions and registrations above describe the imported originals. Packaged surfaces are now simplified mobile derivatives, not byte-identical source geometry.
